system.description:
You can now focus in on an enemies weaknesses and foresee their most critical openings. While your Miraigan is active, you gain the Prophetic Weakness ability

Prophetic Weakness. As a Bonus action you can spend 2 Foresight and select one creature you can see and foretell their weakness. Until the beginning of your next turn, they take +2 bonus damage from all sources. This increases to +4 at 7th level and +6 at 15th level.
